offer.text: The salmon run thick while it's raining and vanish the moment it clears. Land me 5 of them — but only while the rain holds. Once it stops, the chance is gone.

accept.text: Then don't dawdle — cast while the clouds are with you.

decline.text: Fair enough. Not everyone's mad enough to fish a downpour.

in_progress.text: Still raining — still biting. Keep at it!

ready.text: Five rain-fat salmon. The river was generous today.

complete.text: Caught while the sky wept — those are the sweetest. My thanks.

failed.text: The rain's gone and so are the salmon. They'll not run again until the next storm. Ah well — there's always the next.
